goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Mapping, exact-one-active validation, immutable source hashing, schema validation, no-auto-commit enforcement, endpoints, and all repository gates are proven. However, the integration test manually marks a created task completed and calls the receipt writer directly; it does not exercise the exact settled-task finalization path used by executeTask or assert the linked run.json persisted beside the receipt. The oracle explicitly requires preview -> run -> receipt without bypassing existing execution safeguards, so one narrow backend TDD repair is required.

worker_package.objective: Add a shared testable post-execution finalization seam used by executeTask and prove it persists GoalBuddy linkage in run.json together with the separate receipt artifact.
stop_if: The repair needs files outside allowed_files.
The test cannot exercise the same post-execution function called by executeTask.
The repair changes GoalBuddy state, selects another external task, or enables commits.
A goal-owned verification command fails twice for the same unexplained reason.

evidence: Focused GoalBuddy bridge test passes exact mapping, zero/multiple-active rejection, receipt schema, source hash equality, and outcome semantics.
server/index.ts routes /api/goalbuddy/runs through previewGoalBuddyTask, validateQueue, createRun, project lock, persist, and execute.
server/index.ts executeTask calls writeGoalReceiptEnvelopeV1 after status settles, then persists the run.
Current test invokes createRun and writeGoalReceiptEnvelopeV1 directly instead of the shared executeTask finalization path.
Fresh npm test passes 35/35; npm run check, npm run build, git diff --check, and board checker pass.
missing_evidence: Automated proof that the exact post-execution seam used by executeTask writes both goalReceiptPath/linkage into persisted run.json and the separate receipt file.
required_board_updates: Activate T004, complete its TDD repair, then queue a fresh final Judge audit instead of reusing this completed T999 card.
